context:
This is a polyglot monorepo template for single-developer + agentic (GitHub Copilot) workflows.

Key folders:
- services/api/ — Python / FastAPI service; tests in services/api/tests/ (pytest)
- services/frontend/ — Next.js 15 (App Router); tests in services/frontend/__tests__/ (Jest + RTL)
- observability/ — LGTM stack (Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus, OTEL Collector)
- proxy/ — Traefik reverse proxy config
- .github/dispatch-agent/ — autonomous issue implementation pipeline
- .github/skills/ — Copilot skills (grill-me, tdd, prd-to-issues, write-a-prd)
- .github/instructions/ — per-context Copilot instructions (applyTo patterns)

Conventions:
- Each service has a Makefile with test/lint/build targets (run inside Docker for local dev)
- Inside the dispatch-agent container, invoke test/typecheck directly without Docker
- Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): description
- No secrets committed; .env files gitignored, .env.example kept up to date
- All Dockerfiles: multi-stage build, non-root user (app), Alpine/slim base, HEALTHCHECK
